question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**exacerbating**" means making a bad situation worse. In this context, it refers to firecrackers worsening the pollution levels. (बढ़ाना)
 
• The other options: "**destroy**," "**reducing**," and "**augmenting**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Concerned about the pollution levels and the role firecrackers played in exacerbating__ it, the Supreme Court last October banned the sale, use and manufacture of crackers that were not 'green'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Destroy (नष्ट करना):** Means to put an end to the existence of something by damaging or attacking it. It does not fit the context here.
 
• **Reducing (कम करना):** Means to make something smaller or less in amount. It is the opposite of what is needed in this context.
 
• **Augmenting (बढ़ाना):** Means to make something greater by adding to it. Although similar, it is not as precise as "exacerbating" which specifically implies worsening a negative condition.
